title.title: Congruent copies of finite patterns in planar point sets

editorial_contributions.text: Summary: We give upper and lower bounds for various Diophantine exponents associated with the standard linear actions of \(\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathcal O_K)\) on the punctured complex plane \(\mathbb C^2 \setminus \{ \mathbf{0} \}\), where \(K\) is a number field whose ring of integers \(\mathcal O_K\) is discrete and any complex number is within a unit distance of some element of \(\mathcal O_K\). The results are similar to those of \textit{M. Laurent} and \textit{A. Nogueira} [Acta Arith. 154, No. 4, 413--427 (2012; Zbl 1273.11106)] for the \(\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb C)\) action on \(\mathbb R^2 \setminus \{ \mathbf{0} \}\), albeit our uniformly nice bounds are obtained only outside of a set of null Lebesgue measure.
